text:
Lee: CI turned red on my feature branch after the rebase onto main — failing integration tests in inference/integration: TestTimeouts. anyone have a minute to help triage?
Sara: which shard is it failing on? can you paste the failing log tail?
Lee: shard 7/12. here's the log snippet I grabbed: ```AssertionError: request timed out after 30s
  File "tests/integration/test_timeouts.py", line 48, in test_inference_timeout
    assert response is not None
TimeoutError: deadline exceeded```
ci-bot: Build #245678 (branch: feature/fast-kv) failed — failing tests: inference.integration.TestTimeouts (shard 7).
Tom: looks like a real timeout but could be infra. try a quick rerun of that shard first: `/ci rerun --build=245678 --shard=7` or hit the RERUN button in the UI.
Sanjay: if rerun flakes again we should bisect. I can run a local bisect tomorrow morning if someone can give me the commit range.
Lee: rebased onto main @ 1832001110. Last merge from main pulled in a change from Maria that touched retry/backoff (commit 1832000001).
Sara: @Maria tagging you because of the backoff tweak — can you confirm whether the new defaults reduce timeouts? also try `pytest tests/integration/test_timeouts.py::test_inference_timeout -q -k shard7 -s` locally with `INTEGRATION_TIMEOUT=60` to reproduce.
Maria: looking now — my change adjusted retry delay from 50ms->20ms to speed up fast paths, but I didn't touch the max deadline. will run the test locally. fwiw infra had some packet drops earlier in region-west. @devops any alerts?
devops: We had an intermittent networking blip in region-west around 10:12 UTC — packetloss spiked for ~90s. CI jobs running around then could see extra latency. No ongoing incidents.
Sara: ok, rerun queued by me for the shard, keeping env `INTEGRATION_TIMEOUT=60`.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Sara for Build #245678 shard 7 — started.
ci-bot: Rerun completed — shard 7: PASSED. Full build still running (other shards queued).
Lee: nice, thanks. if the full build goes green I'll proceed with merge. if it flakes again I'll ask for a bisect.
Tom: also filing a quick flaky-test note: `test_inference_timeout` — tagging with flaky label so we can track frequency. :memo:
Sanjay: if it repros consistently I'll take the bisect, otherwise happy with rerun + infra note.
Maria: pushed a tiny revert to my backoff tweak branch to test whether that changes behavior; will open PR shortly.
Lee: thanks all — will monitor the build and post final status here. :thumbsup:
